notes.title: Sparkball is live for Steam Next Fest! Let's play!
notes.notes:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40390598/9a17fd8daf7d0f00d6b5ebf13a1dab3c127f0721.jpg"][/img]
Lace up your sneakers, find your Spark, and kick off your official Sparkball career during Steam Next Fest 

[b]🎮 Matchmaking FINALLY Returns!
[/b]From June 9–16, Sparkball is back with ranked matchmaking for Steam Next Fest. If you’ve never experienced an down-to-the-wire, armpits sweaty ranked Sparkball match… we're sorry it took this long, come play one on June 9th.  Play 10 matches to unlock the exclusive 'Beach Day' Inksy skin for Season Zero! 

🔥 Download now to get started and visit our [url="http://explore.sparkball.gg"]EXPLORE[/url] info hub to learn more, including new player and detailed hero guides to help you dominate day 1!

See you on the field![/p]

notes.title: A sports brawler meets a MOBA in Sparkball with a demo coming to Steam Next Fest
notes.notes:
If you love sports and fast-paced action, Sparkball will be one you need to check out with a playable demo coming in Steam Next Fest.

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2025/06/a-sports-brawler-meets-a-moba-in-sparkball-with-a-demo-coming-to-steam-next-fest/

notes.title: Get Ready for Tryout 2 Starting on 12/12!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40390598/3d9c7ef483aa6fabd5cfc8a6a6d5f9b2008d7781.png[/img]

All skill levels are welcome! Never played before? No worries! There are lots of players just starting out and even the vets are pretty chill and welcoming. It's a great way to see what Sparkball's all about.

See you there!

notes.title: New to the game or ready to take the next step?
Best Sports Game Winner - Gam3 Awards
Tryout 1 is About to Begin!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40390598/6bc882a01f8c08b41a0fe01313b2b7ac92426fff.jpg[/img]

Only 12 hours remain before Tryout 1! Sparkadia.gg is now live for registration and you can predownload the game at letsplay.sparkball.gg to be ready the moment the servers go live! 

We’ll be doing four hours of open play with matchmaking on November 21st from 4PM - 8PM UTC. 

See you on the field.

notes.title: Ready to play Sparkball?
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40390598/2076b4d11505a7394bdb86f450d39e955828e48e.jpg[/img]

Remember, the first Tryout for Season Zero starts this Thursday, November 21st!  

So get ready, Sparkadians, and we'll see you soon.

notes.title: Get ready for Season Zero - Tryout 1!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40390598/5f4d4dfc6ba04ddd372c4ba332f13506cc01abfe.png[/img]
On November 21st, you’ll have a chance to play Sparkball right here with your friends! The servers will be open for four hours (4PM - 8PM UTC) and we'll be playing (and streaming) right along with you. 

This is a great time to familiarize yourself with the game and enjoy some low-stakes competition. More playtests are planned throughout December and beyond. We can’t wait to see you all!

Let’s play Sparkball!

notes.title: Sparkball Nominated for Three GAM3 Awards
notes.notes:

Thanks to everyone who's helped us get here. We can't do it without you.
